title: Nanostructured MnOx/g-C3N4 for photodegradation of sulfamethoxazole under visible light irradiation
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,36378-36389
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA05996D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Oanh T. K. Nguyen, Vinh Huu Nguyen, Nong Xuan Linh, Minh Que Doan, Lan-Anh T. Hoang, Taeyoon Lee, Trinh Duy Nguyen
The MnOx/g-C3N4 heterojunction photocatalyst, with enhanced charge separation and redox capabilities, achieved 85% sulfamethoxazole degradation, exhibiting high reusability with minimal ecological risk.
